title: Noodle missing from Generation trigger filters
reality: v2.3.4 added Noodle to Lorebook entry Generation filters, so an entry can be gated to fire only during Noodle timeline context assembly without leaking into chat/continue/autonomous generation paths (#3842).
fix: In 'Generation Trigger Types & Folders', extend the trigger list to include noodle (Noodle timeline refresh) as a v2.3.4 addition, and cross-reference it from the v2.2 Noodle note in the Scope section: entries can now target Noodle-only injection via generationTriggerFilters.

title: Semantic matches now equal budget priority to keyword matches
reality: v2.3.4 gave current semantic (vector) lorebook matches the same context-budget priority as current keyword matches — configured entry order alone, not activation method, decides which entries fit when the tokenBudget can't hold all matches. Before 2.3.4 semantically-activated entries were effectively second-class in budgeting.
fix: In 'Token Budget Management' and/or the v2.2 vector-fallback paragraph, add a v2.3.4 note: semantic-activated entries compete for the token budget on equal footing with keyword-activated ones; only entry order (plus constant/group weighting) determines budget-skips.

title: Entry content now reaches the model verbatim (no HTML-escaping)
reality: v2.3.4 stopped HTML-escaping angle brackets in prompt leaf content: lorebook entry content (along with card fields, persona, memories, scene text) reaches the model verbatim — <thinking>, <scenario>, <div> pass through as written. Supersedes #3108; only structural wrappers and agent value/attribute escapers still escape.
fix: Add a v2.3.4 note in 'Entry length' / Best Practices or near the content field row: entry content with angle brackets or inline HTML/XML is injected verbatim as of 2.3.4 — safe to author entries with markup or pseudo-tags.

title: Roleplay Active Context lorebook detail parity
reality: v2.3.4 matched Roleplay's Active Context lorebook details to Conversation and Game: activation sources, matched keys, semantic scores, current-location grouping, budget skips, and expandable entry content (#3840).
fix: In 'UI Location' where the World Info Inspector / active-entry view is described, add that as of 2.3.4 Roleplay's Active Context shows the same full lorebook diagnostics as Conversation and Game.

title: Embedded-lorebook data preserved through partial PATCH and card validation
reality: v2.3.4 deep-merges partial nested Character PATCH fields without materializing destructive defaults, preserving embedded-lorebook data (#3858); card validation/normalization before persistence preserves unknown embedded-lorebook properties (#3859).
fix: In the 'Character Lorebook tab' subsection, add a v2.3.4 note: embedded lorebooks survive partial Character PATCHes (#3858) and unknown embedded-lorebook properties survive native card validation (#3859).
